title: Fence global mailbox aliases when a new MCP bridge receives a legacy participants array
outcome: A new bridge talking to a host that returns the legacy participants array does not infer complete global name inventory or route mail to a visible namesake while another host is unavailable; exact identities remain usable.
acceptance: A legacy participants-array response causes the bridge to recover unavailable-host information from the existing directory endpoint or to mark global alias inventory incomplete before selecting a Name or name: target.
A bridge regression covers a visible namesake plus unavailable-host uncertainty and proves that global aliases fail closed while exact ids and supported host-qualified references remain usable.
